_about: Sub-processors OpsEngine uses for customer data (GDPR Art 28(2) and (4)). Customers give a general written authorisation in the data processing agreement for the list version they signed; any change to this list needs advance notice to every customer and a chance to object before it takes effect. `python -m opsengine check` flags customers who haven't been told about the current version.
